raw_text_excerpt: Jung Koo Kang - Faculty & Research - Harvard Business School Skip to Main Content HBS Home About Academic Programs Alumni Faculty & Research Baker Library Giving Harvard Business Review Initiatives News Recruit Map / Directions Faculty & Research Faculty Research Featured Topics Academic Units … → Harvard Business School → Faculty & Research → Faculty Faculty Positions Jung Koo Kang Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Read more Jung Koo Kang is an assistant professor in the Accounting and Management Unit. He teaches the Financial Reporting and Control course in the MBA required curriculum. Professor Kang’s research focuses on financial technology and innovation, alternative data, debt contracting, and financial intermediation. Specifically, he examines how emerging technologies and alternative data drive innovation in credit markets and reshape the information dynamics and incentive structures of market participants.
